name: chart7_clum_50km_grid
crs_note: Derived from ABARES CLUM 50m 2023; source raster EPSG:3577. Geometry exported as EPSG:4326.
method_note: 50m categorical raster reduced to approximately 500m using mode, then aggregated into approximately 50km bins. Percentages use mapped land within each bin as denominator.
